rows.p: Not an autoresponder — the person who read your brief, with first thoughts and, if useful, a question or two.
If it looks like a fit. We listen more than we pitch, and you leave with a clear next step either way.
One page: scope, timeline, price — what's in, what's out. You approve it before any work starts.
Honestly and early — often with a pointer to someone better suited. Your time is the thing we waste least.

faq.lede: Anything else — the form above reaches a real person.

items.p: Most projects start within one to two weeks of the first conversation. Quick websites can move even faster if your content is ready.

items.h3: Do you work with businesses outside Kolkata?
items.p: Yes — most of our process runs smoothly over calls, WhatsApp and email. Distance has never been the bottleneck; clarity is.
It depends on what the business needs — pages, features, content. After one short conversation we give a fixed quote with no hidden lines.

items.h3: Do you take care of content and images?
items.p: We can — planning the message, sourcing and optimizing imagery — or we work with whatever you already have. Both are fine.

items.h3: What if I need changes after launch?
items.p: Small changes are part of the engagement. Bigger evolutions get their own honest quote — you'll always know before we build.

qclose.aside: Sometimes one honest conversation answers more than ten emails. If your idea is already formed, reach us directly — we'll pick up or call back within the day.
